import sys

def main():
    tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(tokens)
    while True:
        try:
            n = int(next(it))
            s = next(it)
        except StopIteration:
            break
        paren = False
        start = True
        max_out = 0
        cur_out = 0
        in_words = 0
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            c = s[i]
            i += 1
            if c == '(':
                paren = True
                start = True
                cur_out = 0
            elif c == ')':
                paren = False
                cur_out = 0
            elif c == '_':
                if paren:
                    start = True
                else:
                    cur_out = 0
            else:
                if paren:
                    if start:
                        in_words += 1
                        start = False
                else:
                    cur_out += 1
                    if cur_out > max_out:
                        max_out = cur_out
        print(f"{max_out} {in_words}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
